scope: Pure alpha; fixed95/351ns; complete2ns x1024 analog; local unknownK<=2; ample dynamic range
design: Same NumPy MLP, initialization, minibatch stream and continuous training data; absolute/logarithmic/relative charge risks compared
synthetic: Exact frozen conditional Gaussian likelihood sampler; Q is a conditioning parameter, not newly digitized avalanche charge or deposited energy

training.Q: Single log-uniform500..25000pe; pairs half independent log-uniform500..25000, quarter weak500..3000 +strong6000..25000 in random order, quarter balanced common1000..16000 with ratio exp(uniform[-.35,.35]); reject any individual outside500..25000 or total>48000
training.gaps: Equal mixture uniform4..320ns and log-uniform4..320ns; first onset uniform96..288ns
training.prior: Declared continuous simulation-design distribution only; not a measured source spectrum or a prior fitted to exposed four-energy evaluation labels
training.features: 1021 full FIR innovations +385 observed-single-aligned innovations +log pilotQ and pilot time; asinh(z/3), training-only mean/std, standardized clip[-8,8]
training.one_pilot: Derivative start and integralQ; same single-hypothesis Gaussian NLL, radius24ns,max35 iterations; observed hypothesis, not true K
training.outputs: Two chronological candidate times on -384..384ns/2ns relative grid, locally averaged within two bins of each mode; totalQ pilot*exp(.1*tanh(z)), allocation sigmoid; count2 logit
training.loss: BCE(count2)+3*mean(pair charge risk)+.4*mean(pair time CE); charge risks ((Qhat-Q)/5000)^2,log(Qhat/Q)^2,(Qhat/Q-1)^2; targets used only during training
training.selection: Every500 steps including zero: highest validation forced-K2 strict pair success, then smallest median absolute logQ error, then lowest common count BCE; not blind test performance

evaluation.targeted: balanced/high_weak/weak_high x gap bands6..12,24..64,128..256ns x40 independent Gaussian draws; weak600..1500,strong12000..24000; balanced common3000..15000 times exp(+-uniform[0,.2])
evaluation.prior_shift: 240 pairs: independent uniform500..23000pe and uniform4..320ns; changes training Q/gap distributions
evaluation.controls: 80 empty and80 singles in each continuous Q bin500..1500,1500..5000,5000..12500,12500..25000
evaluation.independence: Continuous evaluation generated only after weight/selection freeze; new parameter/noise seeds; same calibrated mean/noise model, not fresh physical optical parents. Existing native760 frames are exposed transfer diagnostics only.

gate: Each output calibrates learned count2 logit on the same280 native singles, original fitted-singleQ bins1500/5000/12500; plus-one tie-preserving upper rank<=.025; candidates need eachQ>=500; preserve baselineK0/K1 presence
hybrids: Choose risk by the same validation key only. Compare original-NLL refinement vs NLL plus learned-logQ penalty from that candidate; widths=max(.2,validation68th percentile absolute logQ errors) per chronological slot. Same waveform enters network and fit: data-dependent regularization, NOT independent Bayesian evidence.
hybrid_budget: Original and learned two-component starts, each max70 iterations within24ns; preserve best initial candidate under the appropriate objective; all failures retained; count gate separately calibrated
selection: Do not replace default. Development promise requires continuous pair strict success at least baseline+5pp, continuous and native single controls(extra<=5%,success>=95%,medianabsQbias<=5%), and no native pooled pair loss. All comparisons retained.
metrics: Each trueQ>=500; eachQwithin20%; eachtwithinmin(10ns,gap/4); no extra outputs; also missing,extra,split,merge,Q bias/sigma68,t errors,forcedK2 and both-time matches
examples: Native high_weak replicate0 at40 and200ns; full0..2048ns; selected outputs only; absent weak output=0
literature: Reuse Morad2024 detection/estimation separation and caution on trained scores vs likelihood; Kim2023(NIMA168492) supervision/weak-component and synthetic/physical distinction; project MLP, losses and regularization are not paper reproductions
